policy: New definitions are not acquired observations or active scoring weights. Display matched retained values, collect gaps, validate before score promotion.

factors.name: Average contracted rent
factors.definition: Arithmetic mean rent actually paid, with dwelling size and included services specified.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: lower costs can help; not interchangeable with asking rent
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Median contracted rent
factors.definition: Median paid rent for a specified tenure and dwelling cohort.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: a distribution statistic, not a mean
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Net rent per square metre
factors.definition: Paid net rent divided by the source-defined dwelling floor area.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: compare like size, condition and location
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Asking rent per square metre
factors.definition: Quoted rent for advertised dwellings, not all occupied stock.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: new-arrival access context; listing-selection bias
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: New-lease rent
factors.definition: Executed rent for leases commencing in the stated period.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: more relevant to newcomers than old tenancies
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Residential vacancy
factors.definition: Source-defined vacant dwellings divided by its specified total dwelling stock.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: availability and weak demand are different; no universal higher-is-better
factors.limits: Swiss existing binding is mainly 2019, not current. Do not relabel total vacancies as rental vacancies.

factors.name: Rental vacancy
factors.definition: Vacant units available to rent divided by the matching rental inventory.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: separate from for-sale, seasonal and uninhabitable vacancies
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: One-year rent change
factors.definition: Change between comparable rental observations at exact one-year endpoints.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: nominal and real series separate; composition effects disclosed
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Three-year rental trend
factors.definition: Annualised change over exact three-year comparable endpoints.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: no annualised trend from mismatched cohorts
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Vacancy-rate change
factors.definition: End-period vacancy rate minus start-period rate for identical stock and geography.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: not percent growth
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Disposable renter-household income
factors.definition: Income after tax for the renter households relevant to the rent observation.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: do not substitute per-capita or equivalised income
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Observed housing-cost burden
factors.definition: Observed cost/income ratio or distribution for matched households.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: use source population and income concept
factors.limits: A share of households above a threshold is not the average rent/income ratio.

factors.name: Housing-cost overburden share
factors.definition: Share above the source-specific burden threshold.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: EU-SILC over 40% disposable income is distinct from US thresholds
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Area rent/income comparison
factors.definition: Annualised area rent statistic divided by an area income statistic, only with disclosed comparability.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: context ratio, never an observed household burden
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: All-in housing costs
factors.definition: Rent, required service charges, energy and mandatory occupancy costs in a fixed scenario.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: show components; do not double count alongside rent burden
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Income left after essential costs
factors.definition: Fixed household-case disposable income minus housing, travel, childcare and other defined necessities.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: standard scenario with visible assumptions; not personalised advice
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: New housing supply
factors.definition: Completed and usable dwellings, separate from permissions and announced projects.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: supply response context
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Suitable dwelling availability
factors.definition: Available dwellings matching the selected fixed-profile room/accessibility needs.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: do not infer from population or total housing count
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Childcare cost and available capacity
factors.definition: Fixed-case childcare bill and separately measured available capacity/opening hours.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: a low fee is not a guaranteed place
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Essential journey time and cost
factors.definition: Actual usable routes to profile-relevant destinations and fixed travel-cost case.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: straight-line distance is labelled separately
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Step-free housing availability
factors.definition: Usable accessible housing supply with source definition and inspection basis.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: not age share or general housing stock
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Building energy performance
factors.definition: Published certificate or measured consumption with stock and weather basis.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: certificate, model and measured consumption stay distinct
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Residential noise exposure
factors.definition: Mapped or measured exposure by source, day/night metric and time.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: unknown noise must not become quiet=100
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Usable green and outdoor access
factors.definition: Accessible parks, woodland and alpine recreation separated from agricultural and inaccessible land.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: land cover does not establish public access
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Office rent
factors.definition: Office rent for stated grade, location, stock and lease concept.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: asking, contracted, effective and prime rent separate
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Industrial and warehouse rent
factors.definition: Rent for comparable industrial or warehouse premises including size and specification.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: do not use residential rent
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Retail and laboratory rent
factors.definition: Use-specific rent, keeping retail, laboratories and other specialist premises in separate cohorts.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: not interchangeable sectors
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Commercial vacancy
factors.definition: Vacant lettable floor area divided by matching commercial stock.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: not empty-home rate; distinguish physically vacant from marketed availability
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Suitable commercial availability
factors.definition: Immediately usable and marketed supply matching the site specification.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: headline vacancies do not prove suitability
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Commercial rental trend
factors.definition: Comparable same-use rent series with grade, location and incentives held consistent.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: prime index cannot stand in for all premises
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Total occupancy cost
factors.definition: Base rent, service charges, property occupancy charges, required insurance and energy in a fixed case.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: lease incentives and nonrecoverable VAT treated explicitly
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Occupancy cost relative to turnover
factors.definition: Matched sector and establishment-size occupancy cost divided by turnover at the same statistical unit.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: do not mix local premises with multinational consolidated turnover
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Occupancy cost relative to value added
factors.definition: Matched operating-unit occupancy cost divided by comparable value added.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: undefined for zero or negative denominator
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Premises cost per worker
factors.definition: Same establishment cohort occupancy cost divided by full-time-equivalent labour.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: not an area-wide rent/wage ratio
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Employer labour cost
factors.definition: Occupation/sector employer costs including employer contributions and consistent paid-hours definition.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: wages alone omit employer costs
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Relevant labour availability
factors.definition: Occupation-specific workforce and recruitment conditions within the practical catchment.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: total population is not qualified labour availability
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Deliverable power and connection delay
factors.definition: Dated provider evidence for capacity available to the site and connection delivery conditions.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: mandatory gate for power-intensive profiles; not offset by cheap rent
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Electricity cost and reliability
factors.definition: Industrial customer tariff and measured interruption metrics for the service area.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: tariff is not deliverable connection capacity
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Industrial water and wastewater capacity
factors.definition: Dated supply/discharge rights, capacity, treatment and tariff for the activity.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: no household-price substitution
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Enterprise connectivity
factors.definition: Serviceable business connectivity, redundancy, latency and service commitments.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: nominal residential coverage is not an enterprise SLA
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Permits and permitted use
factors.definition: Source-backed process duration and dated site/activity permissions.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: required conditions remain unknown until evidenced
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Freight access and reliability
factors.definition: Usable road/rail/port routes, handling compatibility and reliability.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: not main-line distance without a usable freight terminal
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Operating sector activity
factors.definition: Actual local operating units and sector employment by native classification and period.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: registration addresses and announcements stay separate
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Business survival and expansion outcomes
factors.definition: Cohort-matched survival, closures, expansion and opened capacity.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: independent validation target; avoid score-input leakage
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Operational hazard and insurance exposure
factors.definition: Relevant flood/heat/fire and insurance availability/cost for the location or site.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: source resolution and uncertainty remain explicit
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.

factors.name: Housing feasibility for employees
factors.definition: Residential access and commuting context for fixed worker cohorts.
factors.scoring_promotion: requires cohort-matched held-out validation and current Evidence Lab benchmark gate
factors.interpretation: staff attraction context, never substituted for factory rent
factors.limits: Preserve exact period, geographic support, stock, statistic and source lineage. Missing is not zero.
